But there is a flip side to this cost, and it is the strongest technical
argument for using agent teams in the first place. Large language models
do their best work in the first 40 to 50 percent of the context window;
beyond that threshold, attention degrades and output quality drops. A

to its own role. A three-agent team where each agent uses 30 percent of
its window will produce sharper, more reliable output than one agent
grinding through 90 percent of a single window — and it will do so in a
fraction of the wall-clock time.
